summary: SyncState() in executable_task.go ignores the remainingAttempt parameter and can retry indefinitely on certain error types, unlike Resend() which correctly enforces a retry limit. This inconsistency can cause excessive load on the source cluster during sync failures.
userImpact: Operators running Temporal server in replication scenarios may experience excessive load on the source cluster when sync state operations fail repeatedly.
rootCause: SyncState() does not decrement or validate the remainingAttempt parameter before proceeding, unlike Resend() which implements proper retry limit enforcement with a TODO comment acknowledging the gap.
proposedFix: Apply the same retry limit pattern as Resend(): decrement remainingAttempt at the start, check if less than 0, and return ErrResendAttemptExceeded when the limit is exceeded.
keyQuote: SyncState() can retry indefinitely on certain error types unlike Resend() which correctly enforces the retry limit
